product: Quietcast, a podcast editing service that removes filler words
audience: Independent podcasters who edit their own weekly show
task: A landing page that shows a before and after waveform or transcript of one clip; call to action: try a free 10-minute edit.
facts: Removes 'um', 'uh', long pauses and false starts; keeps breaths unless asked
Sample: a 42-minute episode became 37 minutes 10 seconds; 214 fillers removed
Turnaround: under 15 minutes for a 60-minute file
Editors can restore any cut from the transcript view
£12 per episode hour; first 10 minutes free
Works on WAV and MP3 up to 3 hours; no video
mustInclude: The before and after of one clip
